text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: one plant's mean capacity-normalised output as a share of the other five plants' mean capacity-normalised output, on the hours at which all six plants are scored, by month. Dashed line: 0.8, the plant at 80% of the others' output. Orange: the months below the dashed line. Black: the month in which B0's error is largest among the 8 months not used to screen the arms (the 8 unselected months). Bottom: each arm's mean absolute error minus B0's on the 8 unselected months, over all six plants, in percentage points of capacity. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling months and the three training seeds. Blue: all months in training. Purple: the orange months removed from that one plant's training, for each arm and for B0 alike; the months are still scored. Error minus B0's, with all months in training then with the low-output months removed, in points (negative beats B0): PC -0.23 to -0.04, W7 -0.17 to -0.05, TF -0.14 to -0.11, Q30 -0.07 to -0.08.'
text.tspan: Top: one plant's mean capacity-normalised output as a share of the other five plants' mean capacity-normalised

Bottom: each arm's mean absolute error minus B0's on the 8 unselected months, over all six plants, in percentage
points of capacity. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling months and the three training seeds. Blue:
all months in training. Purple: the orange months removed from that one plant's training, for each arm and for B0
alike; the months are still scored.
Error minus B0's, with all months in training then with the low-output months removed, in points (negative beats

text.aria-label: Title text 'The plant and the months were chosen after the first run, from the whole record, including the 8 unselected months this figure scores. The refit tests whether low-output training months explain B0's error in the black month. It does not estimate a gain a live forecast would see. The top panel leaves out the 2 months that have no hour at which all six plants are scored. The forecasts are out-of-fold: each is made by an XGBoost model that never trained on that month, with whole blocks of months (folds) held out in turn. The forecasts are at lead-day 1, for the day after the day of issue, from three training runs (fitting seeds). XGBoost models are fitted per plant at the primary setting (depth 6, learning rate 0.05, 500 rounds, and row subsampling 0.8). Every estimate in this figure is post hoc: written after the first run's results were known. Arms. B0: the XGBoost baseline with no lagged power. PC (the satellite ratio): the 7-day ratio of power to the satellite irradiance of the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS), and the 30-day ratio of CAMS to forecast irradiance. W7 (the weekly statistics): the minimum, maximum, and mean of power at the same hour over the last 7 whole days. TF: the 30-day ratio of power to forecast irradiance (the transfer ratio). Q30: the 30-day 90th percentile and median of power at the same hour.'
